answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in cedar, checked in violet, and dawn shows each void. A farm of 1056 identities would post 1900 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
